disable: remove or rename the installed braids skill directory
or run opencode with --pure to exclude external plugins for one session
uninstall: confirm with opencode debug skill that braids is no longer listed
conformance: discovery: pass — on 1.18.23 opencode debug skill listed braids with its location resolved to the installed <project>/.opencode/skill/braids/SKILL.md
activation: not-exercised — model-invoked skill selection needs graded runs, not a discovery listing
semantic-parity: not-exercised — requires graded cross-host runs via scripts/run_evals.py --results
progressive-disclosure: pass — OpenCode advertises skill metadata and loads the body on invocation; supporting files stay unread until the model opens them
authority: pass — the adapter installs a skill directory only and declares no permission, agent or tool policy, so it cannot widen the host permission model
degradation: pass — no MCP, LSP or permission dependency is declared, so absent optional tools remove no adapter behaviour
enforcement-truthfulness: not-applicable — this adapter claims no deterministic blocking
state-survival: not-exercised — compaction and resume behaviour was not measured
isolation: not-applicable — no subagents are shipped
uninstall: pass — deleting the skill directory removed braids from opencode debug skill and left no opencode.json entry, because the adapter writes no configuration
limitations: OpenCode has no plugin manifest for skills; opencode plugin installs JavaScript modules, which is a different extension surface that this adapter does not use.
Global skills resolve under ~/.config/opencode/skill(s)/<name>/SKILL.md, not ~/.opencode/; installing to the wrong path silently loads nothing.
Permission policy differs between V1 and V2 configuration, so no permission file is shipped; Guard Mode stays off and any policy must be authored against the installed version.
Subagent recursion and capability limits are version-specific and were not exercised.

OpenCode also auto-loads external skills from ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills, so a Braids copy installed for another host can appear here; OPENCODE_DISABLE_EXTERNAL_SKILLS=1 suppresses that scan.
